page.overview:
Who is Jonda Joestar?

Joji Joestar (adoptive son) Penelope de la Rosa (wife) Joeko Joestar (daughter)|status=Alive|noveldebut=JORGE JOESTAR Chapter 2: Nishi Akatsuki

Jonda appears as a young man with a similar hairstyle to Joji. He has thick eyebrows and appears similarly to Jonathan Joestar.

After his parents had given him up to authorities, Joji is adopted by Jonda. Jonda raises Joji as an English person.

Penelope travels with Joji back to his universe. She falls in love with Jonda and marries him. After a year, the two have a daughter named Joeko.
